guide.title: Hogger's Overview
guide.text:
Hogger is a Bruiser with the unique Ability to create
and get advantage of impassable terrain with terrain outlines,
something that works great in narrow spaces and has low value in wide areas.
This characteristic can be used to easily capture Mercenary Camps
by strategically aiming Hogg Wild.
Thanks to having Rage instead of Mana, Hogger inherently prefers drawn-out battles
that tend to exhaust enemy resources, especially when paired with a sustain
Healer that can keep him healthy for long periods of time.
That said, Hogger has access to a respectable amount of burst damage.

guide.title: Hogger's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Good waveclear
Decent crowd control
Solid damage output, especially when full Rage
Decent mobility
Great at capturing Mercenary Camps
Weaknesses
Weak to poke damage
Countered by percent-based damage
Cannot deal with high-mobility Heroes
Slightly vulnerable to healing reduction effects

guide.title: Hogger's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Hogger synergizes with
Heroes who benefit from impassable terrain with (for example Hanzo
with Scatter Arrow) or without (such as Auriel
with Detainment Strike) terrain outlines can get value
from Loot Hoard.
When enemy Heroes are stuck between Hogger and impassable terrain,
allied Heroes can easily follow up with Abilities
that require their target to stay still for a moment (like Chromie)
or inside one area for a few seconds (for example Stukov).
Having access to a high amount of damage, Hogger can be paired with
another similar Bruiser to have a more solid
frontline than usual. One of them
(usually not Hogger because he will take care of Mercenary Camps)
will be played as Offlaner
whereas the other will stay in the 4-man.
Hogger is countered by
Try to lock Hogger in place with quick and unpredictable crowd control Abilities
and then burst him down before he can get out with either Hogg Wild
or Hoardapult (if selected and not on cooldown after an aggressive play).
Since he has access to Armor, percent-based damage helps with that.
Being a melee Hero, Hogger does not like to play against poke damage
and kite (for example Lunara),
unless he can dive them with the help other Heroes.
There are some Heroes who can easily deny any value which Hogger could get
with impassable terrain thanks to their mobility tools
(such as Zeratul with Blink
or even Medivh with Portal).
Even worse, some of them can use impassable terrain against Hogger thanks to dedicated Abilities
(for example Diablo with Shadow Charge).
Be careful when playing against Heroes who can reduce healing (such as Ana
with Biotic Grenade) because they reduce your survivability
by partially or completely denying the healing provided by your chunks of Meat.
The same is true for Heroes who can reduce your Spell Power,
as it will decrease your self-healing too.

guide.title: Hogger's Maps
guide.text:
Hogger's stronger maps
Hogger's average maps
Hogger's weaker maps
Hogger does well on medium-sized Battlegrounds where he can double soak
(such as Infernal Shrines) and is great on Maps with narrow spaces
where he can get value from impassable terrain,
either by Knocking back
enemy Heroes towards it or by blocking enemy Heroes in small corridors
(notably Cursed Hollow).
Battlegrounds where most of the action happens in wide areas
(for example Hanamura Temple) do not favor Hogger
because he will not be able to get enough value from impassable terrain
and 2-lane Maps will not allow him to dominate the early game
by double soaking.

guide.title: Hogger's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Staggering Blow can be used to Knockback enemy Heroes into Ez-Thro Dynamite.
Ez-Thro Dynamite explodes immediately if thrown directly on enemy Heroes.
Hogg Wild can be used to quickly clear Mercenary Camps between two parallel segments of impassable terrain or, when that is not possible, with the use of Loot Hoard on one side.
Hoardapult has Vector Targeting that allows you to choose on which side of the Loot Hoard you want to land.
Shockwave is easier to use on enemy Heroes previously Slowed with Ez-Thro Dynamite and is a great setup for using Loot Hoard right behind them for getting full value from Staggering Blow immediately after.
Loot Hoard can be canceled before it expires to immediately collect its Meat and/or to open up a path that would be otherwise inaccessible for a few more seconds.
Both Hoardapult and Loot Hoard can be used to interrupt stationary-channeled Abilities.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Hogger's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Thanks to his self-sustain and waveclear,
Hogger is a solid Offlaner who can easily take care of side lanes.
When needed, he is also able to double soak
or quickly capture Mercenary Camps. That said, he can also be paired with
another Bruiser (such as Sonya)
and be played in the 4-man, similarly to a Melee Assassin.
During team fights, Hogger will act as a powerful Bruiser
capable of providing additional peeling for allied Heroes
and dealing a respectable amount of damage to enemy Heroes. Depending on the Build
being played, Hogger can either focus the enemy frontline
or dive the enemy backline.

abilities.title: Hogger's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Staggering Blow can be used to Knockback enemy Heroes into Ez-Thro Dynamite.
Ez-Thro Dynamite explodes immediately if thrown directly on enemy Heroes.
Hogg Wild can be used to quickly clear Mercenary Camps between two parallel segments of impassable terrain or, when that is not possible, with the use of Loot Hoard on one side.
Hoardapult has Vector Targeting that allows you to choose on which side of the Loot Hoard you want to land.
Shockwave is easier to use on enemy Heroes previously Slowed with Ez-Thro Dynamite and is a great setup for using Loot Hoard right behind them for getting full value from Staggering Blow immediately after.
Loot Hoard can be canceled before it expires to immediately collect its Meat and/or to open up a path that would be otherwise inaccessible for a few more seconds.
Both Hoardapult and Loot Hoard can be used to interrupt stationary-channeled Abilities.

abilities.title: Rage
abilities.text:
Hogger has 100 Rage (not scaling) instead of Mana, but it is not used to pay
for Abilities. Instead, it gives cooldown reduction for Basic Abilities
and increases the damage done with Hogg Wild.
The cooldown of your Basic Abilities refreshes 1% faster every 2 Rage stored,
up to 50% additional cooldown refresh rate at maximum Rage, and
Hogg Wild deals 0.5% more damage to enemy Heroes every 1 Rage,
up to 50% additional damage at maximum Rage. There are some Talents
that can be picked to increase the benefits you get from your Rage.
Basic Attacks generate 5 Rage and taking an instance of damage generates 1 Rage.
After not gaining Rage for 3 seconds, you will lose 10 Rage per seconds,
but it will not decay during Hogg Wild.

abilities.title: Staggering Blow
abilities.text:
Staggering Blow
(Q)
Hogger
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Swing your chain in a wide arc, dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. If an enemy hits terrain, deal an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage, Stun for 0.75 seconds, and gain 15 Rage.
Staggering Blow is a Basic Ability that allows Hogger
to damage and Knockback enemy Heroes away from him.
If they hit impassable-terrain
in the process, Hogger gains 15 Rage
while they take bonus damage and get Stunned.
You can use Staggering Blow on Minions or Mercenaries
nearby impassable terrain to quickly get 15 Rage per target Stunned with it,
however, it does not work on Bosses because they cannot be affected by crowd control.
Regardless of the presence of impassable terrain nearby,
you can use Staggering Blow to peel
away enemy Heroes that are threatening your team. If you have good reaction times,
you can also interrupt some animations
(such as Shadow Charge) with it.
When there is impassable terrain nearby, you can use Staggering Blow
to engage on enemy Heroes by pushing them towards it
to trigger the Stun. Remember that
you can use Loot Hoard or Hoardapult
to create your own impassable terrain right behind enemy Heroes when needed.

abilities.title: Ez-Thro Dynamite
abilities.text:
Ez-Thro Dynamite
(W)
Hogger
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Toss a bundle of Dynamite with a 1.5 second fuse. Upon detonation, enemies take 180 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.
The Dynamite instantly detonates when landing on an enemy Hero granting Hogger 10 Rage.
Ez-Thro Dynamite is a Basic Ability that can be used
to throw a Dynamite on the ground. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes.
If the Dynamite lands exactly where an enemy Hero is, then it explodes
without any delay and gives 10 Rage. The explosion deals damage
and applies a Slow to all enemies within range.
You can use the Slow provided by Ez-Thro Dynamite
to better body block enemy Heroes, especially near
impassable terrain, or to increases the chance to hit them with Shockwave.

abilities.title: Hogg Wild
abilities.text:
Hogg Wild
(E)
Hogger
Cooldown: 14 seconds
After 0.25 seconds, become Unstoppable and uncontrollably spin towards the target direction, ricocheting off terrain. Ricocheting off terrain refreshes the duration.
Every 0.125 seconds, deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby non-Structure enemies. Damage against Heroes is increased by .5% for each point of Rage.
Hogg Wild is a Basic Ability with a unique design
that, after a brief delay, gives Hogger Unstoppable
and makes him spin in the chosen direction and damage non-Structure enemies along his path,
ricocheting off impassable terrain marked with terrain outlines
(for example Loot Hoard by Hogger himself)
but ignoring impassable terrain without them
(such as Entomb by Leoric).
While laning, avoid using Hogg Wild for clearing Minions
because it is your escape tool and you want to have it up for when you get
ganked by the enemy team.
During team fights, you can use Hogg Wild to execute
powerful engages to threaten the enemy backline
with the help of at least another allied Hero who can do the same aggressive play.
If you find a good trajectory for it, you can use Hogg Wild
to move from a lane to another faster than when using your Mount,
however, you need to know the exact place and aim required to use this trick,
else you will not get any value out of it because you will end up ricocheting in random directions.
In case you do not like your direction anymore or want to perform other actions,
just press its key again to cancel it, but you cannot do it within 0.5 seconds
from when Hogg Wild actually started.
Hogg Wild is great for clearing Mercenary Camps. You need to
find a way to group all Mercenaries with Staggering Blow, place
Loot Hoard if possible, and then cast Hogg Wild.
You also want to use Ez-Thro Dynamite on cooldown for damage.
See our Hogger Hogg Wild Angles Guide for further information »

abilities.title: Hoardapult
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Hoardapult
(R)
Hogger
Heroic
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.
Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.
Hoardapult is a Heroic Ability with Vector Targeting
that allows Hogger to execute a long and Unstoppable jump,
creating a special Loot Hoard at its final destination.
When hitting the ground, it deals damage to all enemies hit and pushes them away
from its area where the impassable terrain marked with terrain outlines will appear.
The terrain outlines allow Hogger to bounce on it during Hogg Wild.
Upon landing, Hogger applies a Slow to all nearby enemies
and pushes them away, a subtle effect
that can interrupt
stationary-channeled Abilities
(such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.).
The special Loot Hoard created via Hoardapult
throws a chunk of Meat towards Hogger once every 10 seconds
and leaves a chunk of Meat on the ground when it expires or gets canceled,
so you can get up to 3 chunks of Meat from it.
Read the Trait section below for more details about Meat.
Remember to use the Vector Targeting system to choose on which side
of the Loot Hoard you want to land,
else you might find yourself stuck behind impassable terrain and be forced to remove
your Loot Hoard by pressing again the corresponding key,
but only after 0.75 seconds of cooldown.
The special Loot Hoard created via Hoardapult
lasts for up to 20 seconds, but its timer goes insanely fast if Hogger is not within 15 range—the
same as Hoardapult's maximum cast range.

abilities.title: Shockwave
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Shockwave
(R)
Hogger
Heroic
Cooldown: 70 seconds
After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.
Shockwave is a Heroic Ability that provides crowd control.
After a 0.5-second channel, Hogger will Stun for 1.5 seconds
all enemies in a circular area in front of him and for 0.75 seconds all enemies across a line in front of him.
They will also take damage, slightly higher in the initial impact area.
In order to get the most value out of this Heroic Ability, you have to use Shockwave
in melee range as that will Stun enemy Heroes hit for longer.
Hogg Wild can be used as a gap closer
at the beginning of the sequence or as a finisher at the end of the sequence.

abilities.title: Loot Hoard
abilities.text:
Loot Hoard
(D)
Hogger
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Toss a pile of junk onto the battlefield, dealing 102 (+4% per level) damage in an area, knocking enemies away, and acting as terrain for up to 5 seconds.
When the Loot Hoard expires or is destroyed, a chunk of Meat falls out that can be picked up to restore 3% of maximum Health every second for 4 seconds.
Reactivate to destroy Loot Hoard.
Loot Hoard is a Trait that can be used to throw
a block of impassable-terrain
marked with terrain outlines on the battlefield.
When hitting the ground, it deals damage to all enemies hit
and pushes them away, a subtle effect
that can interrupt
stationary-channeled Abilities
(such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.).
The terrain outlines allow Hogger to bounce on it during Hogg Wild.
When it expires or gets canceled, it leaves a chunk of Meat on the ground.
A single chunk of Meat heals Hogger for a total of 12% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds.
In order to collect a chunk of Meat, Hogger has to be almost on top of it.
After 0.75 seconds from its creation, you can cancel Loot Hoard
by pressing the same key in order to free the path and/or immediately collect its Meat.

Pummel (Level 13) Hogger Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 30% for 2 seconds.
Bloodthirst (Level 13) Hogger Damaging Heroes with Basic Attacks, Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild heals you for 33% of the damage dealt.

16.text: Headbanger (Level 16) Hogger Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

Kablooie! (Level 16) Hogger Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%. Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.

Power Spike (Level 20) Hogger Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage. Passive: Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.

No Control (Level 20) Hogger Cooldown: 60 seconds Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby. Cannot be cancelled.

Anger Management (Level 20) Hogger Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%. Passive: Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.

in burst scenarios as you can hit the same Hero multiple times with it.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Hogger
talent_pages.text:
?
Journeyman Cooking
(Level 1)
Hogger
Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health.
Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.
Journeyman Cooking is a situational Quest-based Talent
that heals Hogger by a percentage of his maximum Health for each enemy Hero hit
with Ez-Thro Dynamite. When doing so,
Hogger gains 10 maximum Health, up to 750 additional maximum Health
after stacking 75 times.
Talents that empower Ez-Thro Dynamite have synergy
with Journeyman Cooking because they help you
with its Quest progress: Dense Blasting Powder at Level 7
and Kablooie! at Level 16.
You can pick this Talent when playing Hogger in the 4-man
because it is easier to stack when there are more enemy Heroes nearby
and scales well into the late game.
?
Bones to Gnaw
(Level 1)
Hogger
Loot Hoard creates a chunk of Meat when it lands. While under the effects of Meat, gain 10 Armor.
Bones to Gnaw is a decent Talent that gives Hogger
10 Armor while under the effect of Meat, so for 5 seconds,
and creates a chunk of Meat when Loot Hoard lands.
Bones to Gnaw has synergy with Garbage Fire at Level 7
because it slightly reduces the cooldown of Loot Hoard,
Hoardapult at Level 10 because it creates additional Meat,
and Secret Stash at Level 20 for the same reason.
✔
On The Prowl
(Level 1)
Hogger
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Activate to gain 25 Rage over 8 seconds.
Passive: You heal for 7 (+4% per level) Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.
On The Prowl is a strong Talent that passively
heals Hogger for 8 Health per second, increased by 0.16 Health per point of Rage,
up to 24 Health per second at maximum Rage. Once every 40 seconds, you can activate it to gain
25 Rage over 8 seconds and stop your Rage decay during that time.
You have to pick this Talent when playing Hogger in the offlane
because it gives you self-sustain in the laning phase,
when there is no Healer with you.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Hogger
talent_pages.text:
✘
Brute Force
(Level 4)
Hogger
Increase the range of Loot Hoard by 25% and its damage by 50%.
Quest: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 2, to a maximum of 150 bonus damage. Enemy Heroes that hit terrain grant an additional 6 damage.
Brute Force is a weak Talent that slightly increases
Loot Hoard's range and landing damage. In addition to that, this Talent has a Quest component
that increases Hogger's Attack Damage when hitting enemy Heroes with Staggering Blow,
quadrupled when you successfully Stun them against impassable terrain.
The idea behind Brute Force is to quickly stack up
its Quest by Stunning enemy Heroes against impassable terrain,
else you will take too much time to complete it. As a consequence, this Talent
is better on Maps where team fights happen in narrow areas (such as Cursed Hollow).
The bonus Attack Damage provided by Brute Force
does not scale and it is equal to about 45% additional Attack Damage with Quest completed at Level 20,
resulting in a good synergy with Bloodthirst at Level 13
and Furzerker at Level 16.
When having this Talent, keep in mind that the extra range may cause
Staggering Blow not to Stun
enemy Heroes if they are near you and you cast Loot Hoard
at the new maximum range, however, you can play around it by placing it closer.
We do not recommend picking this Talent because it competes with
Hogger's Joggers. With it, you will have more
survivability because of the increased healing and Movement Speed buffs.
✘
Aggro Range
(Level 4)
Hogger
Increase Hogg Wild's radius by 20% and each enemy hit generates 0.5 Rage, increased to 2 against Heroes.
Aggro Range is a weak Talent that increases
the radius of Hogg Wild and allows it to generate Rage
when hitting enemies, with quadruple value against enemy Heroes.
The only use-case for this Talent is clearing the Guardians spawning
at the Objective on Infernal Shrines because you will be faster
at clearing them and you will also accumulate more Rage for upcoming team fights.
Since it increases your Rage, this Talent has synergy with Rage-based Talents:
Seeing Red at Level 7 and Anger Management at Level 20.
We do not recommend picking this Talent because it competes with
Hogger's Joggers. With it, you will have more
survivability because of the increased healing and Movement Speed buffs.
✔
Hogger's Joggers
(Level 4)
Hogger
While above 35Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received.
When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.
Hogger's Joggers is a strong Talent that gives you
bonus Movement Speed and healing received: 10% when between 35 and 50 Rage
or 15% when above 50 Rage.
We recommend this Talent because the healing increase makes you more durable,
especially with a Healer on your side,
and the Movement Speed helps you a lot when moving around during team fights.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Hogger
talent_pages.text:
?
Dense Blasting Powder
(Level 7)
Hogger
Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit.
Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.
Dense Blasting Powder is a good Talent that increases
the value of Ez-Thro Dynamite in two ways:
directly hitting enemy Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite
and causing it to explode instantly throws a second Ez-Thro Dynamite
behind them;
hitting a Ez-Thro Dynamite that is already on the ground
with Staggering Blow breaks into 3 new instances
of Ez-Thro Dynamite and throws them forward in a line.
Especially when playing with this Talent, you can use Staggering Blow
to Knockback enemy Heroes into soon-to-explode
Ez-Thro Dynamite laying on the ground.
✔
Garbage Fire
(Level 7)
Hogger
Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 20%.
Garbage Fire is a good Talent that slightly reduces the cooldown
of Loot Hoard. In addition to that, enemies around it
take periodic damage and are Slowed by a small amount.
When you have this Talent, you can use Loot Hoard
for clearing Minions. This may be useful when you need to
double-soak or simply to have
priority on the enemy Offlaner.
The damage and debuff effects provided by this Talent count for the special
Loot Hoard created via Hoardapult as well,
so you should pick them together to get more value out of both Talents.
?
Seeing Red
(Level 7)
Hogger
While above 50 Rage, gain 35% Attack Speed and the cooldowns of Staggering Blow and Hogg Wild refresh 30% faster.
Seeing Red is a good Talent that, when above 50 Rage,
increases your Attack Speed by 35% and makes the cooldown of Staggering Blow
and Hogg Wild refresh 30% faster.
Considering that it requires 50 Rage to actually give you some value,
we recommend to combine this Talent with Aggro Range
at Level 4 as it helps you to quickly generate a bunch of Rage.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Hogger
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Hoardapult
(Level 10)
Hogger
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.
Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.
Hoardapult is a strong Heroic Ability that increases
Hogger's survivability and gives him another way to create impassable terrain
with terrain outlines, usable for Staggering Blow
and Hogg Wild as well.
Thanks to its utility, Hoardapult is particularly effective
on Battlegrounds where team fights happen in narrow areas (such as Cursed Hollow)
because you will not be able to get much value from impassable terrain
in wide areas (for example Hanamura Temple).
Prefer picking Hoardapult when you need
an escape tool and/or an additional source of Unstoppable
to play around enemy crowd control.
?
Shockwave
(Level 10)
Hogger
Cooldown: 70 seconds
After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.
Shockwave is a good Heroic Ability that adds
a powerful crowd control tool to your kit
while also increasing your burst damage by a decent amount.
Due to its delay, you should only pick this Heroic Ability when your team features
Heroes who can engage for you. Wait for them to
crowd control someone and then use
Shockwave as follow-up.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Hogger
talent_pages.text:
?
Dust Devil
(Level 13)
Hogger
Gain 25 Armor while Hogg Wild is active and for 4 seconds after. When at or above 50 Rage, increase this Armor to 40.
Dust Devil is a good Talent that gives a considerable amount
of Armor to Hogger during Hogg Wild
and for 3 seconds after that. The amount of Armor
gained is higher when above 50 Rage.
Remember to use Hogg Wild to benefit from the insane defensive
value of Dust Devil when targeted by heavy-hitting Abilities
(such as Pyroblast by Kael'thas).
Considering that having more than 50 Rage makes it more powerful,
Dust Devil has synergy with Aggro Range
at Level 4 because it helps you to quickly generate a bunch of Rage.
✔
Pummel
(Level 13)
Hogger
Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 30% for 2 seconds.
Pummel is a strong Talent that empowers Hogg Wild
so that it immediately reduces the Spell Power of enemy Heroes hit for a few seconds
and constantly debuffs enemies hit with a small but rapidly stacking Slow.
As it reduces Spell Power, you can use Pummel
to reduce the healing and/or damage done by enemy Heroes via Abilities
(for example against Whitemane), especially if they are melee Heroes
and/or lack mobility to dodge Hogg Wild.
The powerful Slow provided by Pummel
can be useful for increasing your chances to hit enemy Heroes
with Shockwave too.
?
Bloodthirst
(Level 13)
Hogger
Damaging Heroes with Basic Attacks, Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild heals you for 33% of the damage dealt.
Bloodthirst is a decent Talent that gives Hogger
the ability to heal himself when damaging enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks,
Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild.
The healing amount will be 1/3 of the damage dealt to them.
As it works with both Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities,
Bloodthirst has synergy with Seeing Red at Level 7
and Furzerker at Level 16.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Hogger
talent_pages.text:
✔
Headbanger
(Level 16)
Hogger
Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.
Headbanger is a strong Talent that improves Staggering Blow,
but only when the Knockback successfully slams enemy Heroes on impassable terrain,
making them take additional damage in the form of percent-based damage
and increasing the Stun duration from 0.75 to 1.25 seconds.
Even if you can combo Staggering Blow with Loot Hoard in wide areas,
avoid picking Headbanger while playing on Battlegrounds
that lack narrow areas (such as Hanamura Temple).
?
Kablooie!
(Level 16)
Hogger
Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%.
Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.
Kablooie! is a good Talent that empowers
Ez-Thro Dynamites that instantly explode on enemy Heroes as follows:
increases their damage, slightly reduces their cooldown, and increases their Slow.
The cooldown reduction you get from Kablooie!
is nice to have because it allows you to constantly annoy enemy Heroes
with your best Slow while also dealing slightly more damage
and gaining a bit more Rage than usual in the process.
The powerful Slow provided by Kablooie!
is useful to increase your chances to hit enemy Heroes
with Shockwave and for repeatedly hitting them with Basic Attacks.
?
Furzerker
(Level 16)
Hogger
Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow or Ez-Thro Dynamite increases the damage of the next Basic Attack within 8 seconds by 50%, stacking up to 2 times.
When Hogg Wild ends, gain 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.
Furzerker is a decent Talent that increases Hogger's
Movement Speed at the end of Hogg Wild for 2 seconds and
the damage done by your next 1-2 Basic Attacks within 8 seconds of hitting enemy Heroes
with Staggering Blow or Ez-Thro Dynamite.
The mentioned Basic Abilities will provide 1 stack per enemy Hero hit.
Basic Attacks will consume 1 stack of Furzerker
to deal additional Physical Damage to enemy Heroes hit.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Hogger
talent_pages.text:
?
Secret Stash
(Level 20)
Hogger
Every 2 seconds, Hoardapults' Loot Hoard randomly launches Ez-Thro Dynamite, prioritizing nearby enemy Heroes.
Every 5 seconds, it also launches a chunk of Meat towards Hogger.
Secret Stash is a decent Talent that drastically increases
Hogger's survivability in prolonged team fights. Once upgraded with this Talent,
Hoardapult launches a chunk of Meat towards Hogger
once every 5 seconds and creates a bit of chaos in the surrounding area
by launching an Ez-Thro Dynamite once every 2 seconds.
Avoid picking Secret Stash when team fights are short
because you will not be able to get value from the additional chunks of Meat.
?
Power Spike
(Level 20)
Hogger
Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage.
Passive: Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.
Power Spike is a good Talent that greatly empowers
Shockwave, making it reduce the Armor
of enemy Heroes hit by a decent amount for multiple seconds. In addition to that,
hitting enemy Heroes with Shockwave will give you 20 Rage
and the cooldown reduction effect provided by your Rage will affect it.
We find Power Spike only playable in team compositions
which want to quickly take down a single enemy Hero with burst damage
because the Armor reduction effect provided is great for doing
so—unless your team already has Armor reduction effect,
considering they do not stack.
?
No Control
(Level 20)
Hogger
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.
Cannot be cancelled.
No Control is a strong Talent that, when activated
while mouse-hovering an enemy Hero, makes Hogger cast an untalented and modified
version of Hogg Wild that follows and damages
enemy Heroes for up to 5 seconds, changing target to a random enemy Hero every time Hogger reaches his target.
When lacking targets, Hogger will just spin on the spot until No Control ends.
You cannot cancel No Control pre-emptively.
Despite the random component, No Control can add
a lot of damage during team fights. Similarly to Hogg Wild,
No Control deals more damage based on the amount of Rage you have,
so try to build up your Rage with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities before using it.
Do not use No Control when enemy Heroes are near
their own Structures and/or have access to mobility tools,
else you will end up dying without accomplishing anything. You have been warned!
✔
Anger Management
(Level 20)
Hogger
Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%.
Passive: Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.
Anger Management is a strong Talent that increases
your maximum Rage and every Rage-related bonus by 50%: cooldown reduction
for your Basic Abilities, Rage generation via Basic Attacks, and damage
against enemy Heroes with Hogg Wild.
Furthermore, Basic Attacks will give 5 additional Rage.
We find Anger Management particularly good in long team fights
because in that case you will easily be able to get past 100 Rage and get more value from it.
You can combine this Talent with Rage-generating Talents to speed up the process:
On The Prowl at Level 1 and Aggro Range at Level 4.
